episodes.synopsis: Lanzhu and Mia arrive in Japan. The School Idol Club starts creating a promotional video for the 2nd School Idol Festival.
episodes.title: A Brand New Thrill

episodes.synopsis: As the girls prepare for the festival, they get a request from Y.G. International Academy to do a joint concert. Emma invites Lanzhu but she declines. Kasumi, Rina, Kanata and Emma follow Lanzhu when they hear she's going to have another surprise concert.
episodes.title: Overlapping Colors

episodes.synopsis: Kasumi, Rina, Kanata, and Emma are excited to perform together, but they're all very different. There isn't much time left before the joint concert, so Rina proposes they all take turns to explain what they want to do, but they still can't seem to agree.
episodes.title: Sing! Song! Smile!

episodes.synopsis: Karin meets Misato Kawamoto, Ai's neighbor. Ai invites Karin to go together with them. Meanwhile, the student council decides to merge the School Idol Festival with the Culture Festival, with Shioriko managing both events.
episodes.title: Ai Love Triangle

episodes.synopsis: Shioriko arranges a pre-show produced by the drama club for the day before the cultural fair. Later, Shizuku tells Yu that she wants to create a unit and perform with Ayumu and Setsuna at the Fair. The next morning, Ayumu and Setsuna follows Yu and Shizuku after finding them together.
episodes.title: Dreamland Is Now Open!

episodes.synopsis: Setsuna hesitates revealing her identity as Nana Nakagawa, as she thinks her personas should be kept separate. Meanwhile, Kaoruko Mifune, a new music course teacher, praises Yu about the combined event.
episodes.title: Choose Your "Love"

episodes.synopsis: The Joint Festival begins. During their time at Shion Academy, the club learns of Kaoruko's past as a school idol, and how Shioriko, her younger sister, looked up to her, hoping to be a school idol herself.
episodes.title: The Memory of Dreams

episodes.synopsis: The final day of the 2nd School Idol Festival has arrived. Today, the festival is happening along with Nijigasaki's cultural fair. But Yu still hasn't finished writing the song for the School Idol Club because she wants to make it the best song possible.
episodes.title: The Place Where the Rainbow Begins

episodes.synopsis: The 2nd School Idol Festival came to a successful close. But then Lanzhu tells the girls that she's going to quit being a school idol and head back to Hong Kong. Mia asks her why she's going home, but Lanzhu just says she's done everything she wanted to.
episodes.title: The Sky I Can't Reach

episodes.synopsis: Second-year Yu Takasaki joins Nijigasaki High School’s idol club with the dream of helping every member make theirs come true!
episodes.title: Kasumin☆Wonder Tour

episodes.synopsis: Second-year Yu Takasaki joins Nijigasaki High School’s idol club with the dream of helping every member make theirs come true!
episodes.title: The Past, the Future, and Now

episodes.synopsis: The School Idol Club is being officially recognized by the school?! Kasumi overhears this news and runs to the club room to tell everyone, only to find out it's just a rumor. But then the girls actually consider what going official could entail for them.
episodes.title: Cheer!

episodes.synopsis: The day of the first live show of the School Idol Club has come and the girls give their best in front of a huge audience.
episodes.title: Let This Thrill Resonate
